## Appearance

Shirley is a woman with a small, pointed chin and distinctively red, ruddy hair worn in a long braid. Her hair has smooth ripples, often decorated with white flowers, and is paired with notable big, wonderful eyes.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) endured a neglected childhood living with different families and at an asylum before being brought to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She subsequently earned the Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and worked earnestly as a dedicated schoolteacher for two years, bonding deeply with her pupil [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). During her time teaching, she acted as a matchmaker to reunite Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), while also coming to terms with the secret engagement of her best friend, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After leaving her teaching post to pursue higher education, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) met Royal Gardner, who began courting her with roses after rescuing her during a rainstorm. While visiting [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), she attended a prayer meeting with [Janet](../character/janet.md) and accompanied her for tea at the home of [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) and his mother. Upon learning that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was critically ill with typhoid fever, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffered a agonizing night of worry before his fever broke, during which she realized her profound love for him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P4](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P6](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), +333 more_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> "I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> “When I’ve finished these exercises I’ll run down and chat awhile with Mrs. Lynde,” said Anne. “I had intended to study some Latin composition tonight but it can wait.”
>
> — Shirley — [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P7](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0007)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are devoted bosom friends and former schoolmates whose bond has endured despite period separations and dramatic goodbyes ordered by Diana's mother. As they transition into adulthood, they remain each other's trusted confidantes, sharing gossip, hopes for the future, and intimate personal milestones like Diana's secret engagement to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md). Though they face upcoming separations as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pursues college and leaves her teaching post, their close emotional connection remains intact.

- Friend of — bosom friends and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), +2 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) initially began as Anne's fierce academic rival for top marks in school and at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), but their intense competition eventually gave way to a close friendship. He supports Anne's ambitions, showing delight when she resigns her teaching post to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Their bond gradually shifts over time, evolving into a quiet, mutual romantic awakening, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences a lonely ache during periods when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is absent and unable to write to her.

- Rival of — intense academic rivalry for top marks in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- Friend of — friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) is Anne's imaginative young student who bonded with her on her very first day of teaching, frequently gifting her flowers and sharing his creative stories. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) acts as a mentor and close friend to [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), appreciating his unique worldview and taking him on visits to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). As [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) grows older and prepares to leave childhood imaginings behind, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remains a supportive guide who helps him navigate growing up.

- Friend of — student who likes his teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), +1 more</sub>
- Mentor of (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)</sub>

### [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/shirley--stella-maynard.md)

[Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) is a close friend and correspondent of Anne's. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes detailed letters to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) sharing humorous stories and anecdotes about her school pupils. During Anne's time away at college, [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) is part of Anne's circle of friends who share in the excitement and romantic speculation surrounding Anne's suitors.

- Friend of — correspondent and close friend (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Douglas P18](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0018)</sub>
